scope: Same-process pre-repair released computation, precision-matched previous schedule, selected CuTe and actual default SDPA; B1/H16 contiguous BHSD, FP16/BF16 dense/causal. Warmed resident GPU forward, retained-forward backward, and complete forward/backward. Compilation, allocation and graph capture excluded; device-event intervals include graph-entry/node scheduling and any submission stalls.

protocol.ordering: Rotate all selected backends each round; actual replay counts retained.
protocol.control: Disable only sm120_schedule.eligible; shared precision repairs remain enabled. This is the precision-matched previous schedule.
protocol.released_control: Disable sm120_schedule.eligible, sm86.eligible and l40s.eligible, and replace kernels.precision_schedule with identity accepting **kwargs. This reconstructs3e17149 computation under the current compiler, not the historical binary.
protocol.reference: Full-length centered FP64 on identical rounded inputs, two-head chunks.
protocol.accuracy_gate: Each output/dQ/dK/dV norm-relative error below 1% BF16 or 0.5% FP16; exact zero when reference norm is zero.
protocol.pointwise_gate: Each output/dQ/dK/dV element also meets atol=rtol=0.02 BF16 or 0.003 FP16. Failed released or SDPA rows remain diagnostic.
protocol.kernel_verification: Actual graph functions/resources after uninstrumented timing. Activity profiling uses a separate process and is never initialized here.
protocol.phase_note: Backward retains a forward graph; separately timed medians need not sum to the complete-call median.

measurements.released_role: Pre-repair computation through current compiler; failed precision is diagnostic.
measurements.sdpa_role: Qualified performance comparator; not the numerical oracle.
measurements.graph_validation: Each captured phase meets strict FP64 component gates on identical inputs. Changed-input replay additionally agrees with fresh eager execution; independent changed-data FP64 checks are in the GPU qualification suite.
